facts.fact: 沙发晨起：他已去上班，晨吻制度头一回缺席。
facts.anchor: Without waking me with a kiss on the forehead to say good morning.

facts.fact: 童年禁令：不许光脚在家走动——光脚是她唯一「不会被卷走」的踏实感。
facts.anchor: My eyes instantly find the door, fearing punishment for this too, because as a child, I was constantly told off for wandering around the house without any socks or slippers on.

facts.fact: 他对 Luna 的定性：野生动物、啮齿类——「它也恨我，它去别处更开心」。
facts.anchor: It’s nothing but a wild animal. A rodent. The thing hates me, anyway.

facts.fact: 同居的猫条款：家具每天吸、猫砂随拉随铲、砂盆只许放 spare room。
facts.anchor: every single day I meticulously study the floor for stray grey stones that have jumped from the lip of the tub.

facts.fact: 猫失踪那天：他摔门之后——窗大开。他发誓不知情，「也许是它自己弹开的」。
facts.anchor: So, when I burst into the room and spotted the window wide open, blinds clashing together, I felt danger slap me across the face

facts.fact: 她独自冒雨找猫两个多小时——他不去，还说她「疯了，猫没事的」。
facts.anchor: I flung myself outside, without my usual fears, and wandered the streets of the Southside for over two hours, my body becoming numb with clingy wet clothes.

facts.fact: 他出门领人：动机不是担心她，是「别人会怎么看我」。
facts.anchor: ‘You’ve been gone ages, Cassie. I can’t have you out here alone. What will people think of me?’ he said.

facts.fact: 团圆：Luna 蜷在倒木下避雨——他看了一眼，摇头，一言不发；此事再未谈过。
facts.anchor: found her cowering under a fallen tree. Shielding herself from the rain.
